## Research Summary

This project builds a firm-year data system for leading global corporate R&D investors. It connects R&D expenditure, patents, trademarks, industry, country, firm identity, and year so that technology-oriented and market-oriented innovation assets can be analysed in the same empirical structure. The current emphasis is data construction and measurement audit rather than completed causal findings.

## Abstract

<p class="abstract-text">The project develops a structured firm-year innovation dataset for high-R&D firms by linking R&D investment, patent records, trademark records, industry classifications, country information, firm identifiers, and time. Its purpose is to support later analysis of corporate innovation portfolios without reducing innovation to a single output count. The current work focuses on entity matching, intellectual-property linkage, panel construction, and measurement consistency.</p>
